The workflow is valid. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_cpl_003
steps:
  - id: receive_game_form
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      schema:
        required_fields:
          - home_team
          - away_team
          - league
          - date
          - time
          - venue
    output: game_form_data

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: admin
    output: admin_auth

  - id: validate_home_team_league
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: teams
      filter:
        team_id: "{{game_form_data.home_team}}"
        league_id: "{{game_form_data.league}}"
    output: home_team_record

  - id: validate_away_team_league
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: teams
      filter:
        team_id: "{{game_form_data.away_team}}"
        league_id: "{{game_form_data.league}}"
    output: away_team_record

  - id: validate_teams_in_league
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "home_team_record != null AND away_team_record != null"
      on_fail: terminate
      message: "Both teams must belong to the specified league"
    output: league_validation

  - id: check_home_team_conflict
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: games
      filter:
        team_id: "{{game_form_data.home_team}}"
        date: "{{game_form_data.date}}"
    output: home_conflict_records

  - id: check_away_team_conflict
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: games
      filter:
        team_id: "{{game_form_data.away_team}}"
        date: "{{game_form_data.date}}"
    output: away_conflict_records

  - id: apply_conflict_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "home_conflict_records.count == 0 AND away_conflict_records.count == 0"
      on_fail: terminate
      message: "A team cannot play two games on the same date"
    output: conflict_check

  - id: insert_game_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      table: games
      operation: insert
      data:
        home_team: "{{game_form_data.home_team}}"
        away_team: "{{game_form_data.away_team}}"
        league: "{{game_form_data.league}}"
        date: "{{game_form_data.date}}"
        time: "{{game_form_data.time}}"
        venue: "{{game_form_data.venue}}"
        status: scheduled
    output: game_record
